correctness.rationale: Published Zhang integral decomposition is valid input, not independently reproved. Symmetric-group minimum inversion for exact descent set D equals λ(D)=sum binom(a_i+1,2) with unique reversing-run witness; checked independently for n=2..8 (128 masks at n=8). A nonchordal induced C yields reduced H1(S^1)=Z and shifted summand at 2λ(C)+2. Any earlier positive even contribution would require an odd-degree induced-clique class, hence some chordless cycle C⊆D and degree>=2λ(D)+2>=2λ(C)+2. Equality gives exactly one generator per minimum cycle. Chordal induced clique complexes are positively acyclic. Finite enumeration corroborates, not proves unbounded r.

originality.rationale: Although the induced-cycle minimum-cost and free-rank summary is not printed verbatim in Zhang, the earlier published Theorem1.1/5.4 gives the *entire integral homology for all indexing complexes*, including each special flag-indexed group. Ordinary longest parabolic descent lengths and chordal clique homology directly yield the positive even criterion and earliest-degree rank, making the submitted final homology statement an implied special case of prior stronger general coverage. A more economical cycle formulation is not a new uncovered homology fact under the implication originality bar.
residual_risks: The explicit weighted-induced-cycle optimization and linear-time chordality diagnostic are not printed in Zhang; under a stricter independent-method standard they might be considered an original reorganization, but all resulting homology data are implied.
Higher even homology and torsion are not classified by the submitted criterion (though Zhang formula covers them).
